maps.effective_enable: f <- f XOR (e AND NOT z)

primitive_obligation.full_domain: P is a computational-basis permutation on its complete declared register domain
primitive_obligation.accumulator_requirement: For each fixed q,s and f=1, R -> R boxplus T_s(q) is the frozen exception-aware bijection on every encoded R, including O, A, -A, and -2A; f=0 is identity
primitive_obligation.inverse_requirement: The frozen subtraction action supplies the inverse permutation
primitive_obligation.mask_cleanup_condition: If mu depends on R, P must transport M from f*mu(q,s,R) to f*mu(q,s,R'); preservation of the pre-map mask is insufficient in general
primitive_obligation.alternative_if_R_not_a_load_control: The loaded mask must be independent of R or must be computed and cleaned inside P

unitary.full_domain_reason: X, CX, polarity-declared MCX, and P are computational-basis permutations; their composition is a basis permutation and its linear extension is unitary
unitary.superposition_action: Every exact input amplitude is transported within the same lambda block; no cross-block key is introduced

cleanup_trace.state_change: R -> R'=R boxplus beta*T_s(q); Q preserved; M -> beta*mu(q,s,R'); W:0 -> 0
Q -> 0; M -> 0 using the post-map controls

liveness.f: first compute through completion of unload
liveness.Q: forward load through arithmetic use, ending at unload
liveness.M: forward load through exceptional arithmetic use and any mask transport, ending at unload
liveness.W: inside P only; zero at entry and exit
liveness.q_s_e_z: immutable throughout and live as controls where used
liveness.R: entry through arithmetic and, for an R-dependent mask, through unload

ordering_failures.unload_before_use: P no longer receives its required live Q and M input
ordering_failures.missing_unload: Q or M remains a label-dependent or accumulator-dependent residual work value
ordering_failures.pre_map_mask_cleanup: An exceptional predicate is destroyed before its required reversible use

counts.convention: Only the coherent signed-window/qROM correction layer is counted; P is one controlled invocation and its internal gates are excluded

definitions.h_j: Hamming weight of forward-loader output-bit truth table F_j
definitions.T[p,n]: Number of forward-load minterms with p positive and n negative controls
definitions.B_minus: Total opened-and-closed negative-control wire intervals across both loader directions
definitions.c_dec: Peak clean ancillae of the selected elementary MCX decomposition
definitions.d_dec: Peak dirty ancillae of the selected elementary MCX decomposition

relations.primitive_workspace_separate: b_W additional clean workspace bits, plus any separately declared primitive ancillae

counts.negative_control_rule: Each opened-and-closed negative-control wire interval contributes exactly two X gates; no interval may close in a way that removes a live exceptional predicate before P
counts.hamming_weight_rule: Every output bit with truth-table Hamming weight h contributes h forward controlled target toggles and h inverse-load toggles before decomposition
counts.upstream_ceiling: A leading 3n+O(log n) expression is only a conditional composition with separately supplied arithmetic bounds and is not derivable from this correction layer

sparse_exact_amplitude_check.state_representation: finite map from (q,s,e,z,R,f,Q,M,W) to exact symbolic or algebraic amplitude
sparse_exact_amplitude_check.gate_update: apply each basis permutation to every key and transport its exact amplitude unchanged
checks: q,s,e,z remain equal to their input labels
each f=0 block is identity on R
each f=1 block applies the frozen exception-aware accumulator action
exact amplitudes and exact norm are preserved
f,Q,M,W are zero on every final nonzero-amplitude key

known_false_reasoning_controls.required_detection: per-block accumulator check rejects unchanged R

known_false_reasoning_controls.witness: exact superposition on at least two addresses
known_false_reasoning_controls.required_detection: gate-by-gate coherent-permutation check rejects the absence of one reversible map

known_false_reasoning_controls.witness: row with nonzero loaded coordinate or mask
known_false_reasoning_controls.required_detection: final-work check finds Q or M nonzero and correlated
liveness check finds the predicate dead before P

known_false_reasoning_controls.witness: e=1,z=1 with a non-identity row action

known_false_reasoning_controls.required_detection: exact exception check rejects at least one key by the control definition
